newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on liquidity crunch.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer on liquidity crunch.

text.p: Banks maintained attention to the call money trade amid a temporary liquidity crunch, helping Bangladesh taka to end firmer at 42.4900/42.5100 to the dollar in interbank trading ahead of Thursday's public holiday, dealers said.

Taka was quoted stronger at 42.5000/5200 per dollar in early trade and gained further amid large demand for the local currency. "It seems withdrawal (of deposits) ahead of Eid-ul Fitr festival has put some banks in temporary trouble," said one dealer.
The call money was traded at 9.0 to 9.5 percent, up from Tuesday's 8.0-9.0 percent.
